title: drydocs_core/ontology/relationship_vocabulary/*.yaml fragments
description:
Shape only (S6), fragment-aware: a fragment is either a mapping carrying one or more sections (node_classifications / property_terms / prov_matrix / local_relationships), a bare list of local-relationship entries (the 4x-local domain files), or the comment-only header (empty document). Gate-bound activation semantics live in the vocabulary accessor + writers.

CLOSED AT THE ENTRY LEVEL (CFG3, 2026-09-07). The mapping branch was ALREADY closed, so the top-level closure this item asks for was a no-op here -- the hole was one level down, on `local_relationship`, where a misspelled key on an entry passed in silence. Closing it required declaring six keys the live fragments use and no schema named: deprecated_at, deprecation_note, superseded_by (the G87 deprecation trio), skos_maps_to and sosa_maps_to (standards mappings beside the declared prov_maps_to), and join_key. Every one was already in the tree; none was invented to make the schema pass.

deprecated_at.description: Date the entry was superseded — a bare YAML date parses to a date object, so this is left untyped exactly as `updated` is in the sibling family schemas. G87's add-new + deprecate-old rule; never a rename in place, because the id is the join key across the map, the generated Cypher, the SQLite mirror and the gate log.

superseded_by.description: The id that replaces this one.

join_key.description: The identifier the two ends are joined on where the edge is derived from a keyed extract rather than from structure.
